---
title: "CTD Fluorescence Correction Pipeline (KC10, FZH01)"
output: html_notebook
---

This notebook turns raw CTD fluorescence profiles from KC10 and FZH01 into a
chlorophyll product calibrated against discrete samples. It runs from raw
Portal downloads to the final CSV. The exploratory analysis behind these choices
(dark offset investigations, replicate-cast timing, slope seasonality and
biomass dependence, low-biomass fits) is in the original workbook
`CTD Fluorometer Correction Workbook`, kept as an archive.

**Steps**

1. Keep downcasts and profiles passing visual QC (`fluorescence_QC_flags_*.csv`).
2. Dark offset: median of the 10 lowest values deeper than 100 m, per cast,
   subtracted from the profile (floored at 0). Casts too shallow for this get
   the nearest deep offset from the same sensor.
3. Average replicate casts by date, station, depth and sensor.
4. Discrete chlorophyll: bulk GF/F, gap-filled with the size-fractionated sum.
5. Cast-by-cast regressions of discrete chlorophyll on fluorescence, with and
   without the 1 m sample (to handle surface quenching).
6. Sensor-wide calibrations from casts flagged AV in `ctd_discrete_flags5.csv`
   plus 1-2 sample casts. Applied as `f_calibrated = slope * f_dm`. The intercept
   is deliberately not applied: the dark offset has already been removed, so the
   calibration is treated as a pure gain.
7. NPQ hybrid correction for profiles listed as AV in `quench_correction_fits.xlsx`.
8. Saturated profiles replaced with interpolated discrete chlorophyll.

**Manual decisions** live in two files rather than in the code:
`manual_decisions.csv` (outlier exclusions, separate calibration groups,
saturated profiles, each with a reason) and `quench_correction_fits.xlsx`
(which profiles get NPQ correction, with per-profile settings and comments).
In the quench file, `SVD` means "do not apply the correction".

**Output columns** of the final file include `f_dm` (dark-corrected daily-mean
fluorescence), `f_calibrated` (slope-corrected), `f_final` (best estimate:
NPQ- or saturation-corrected where applicable, otherwise `f_calibrated`) and
`profile_correction` (which correction produced `f_final` for that profile).

```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(patchwork)
library(rioja) # interp.dataset() for saturated profiles

source(here("functions", "fluor_qc_functions.R"))

make_figures <- TRUE # set FALSE to just produce the output files
run_date <- Sys.Date()
```

```{r settings}
# Input files
paths <- list(
  ctd       = here("files", "8_binAvg-1762199720021.csv"),           # Portal CTD profiles
  ctd_flags = here("outputs", "fluorescence_QC_flags_20251103.csv"),  # visual profile QC
  chl       = here("files", "2025-11-03_HakaiData_chlorophyll.csv"),  # discrete chl
  hplc      = here("files", "2025-11-18_HakaiData_hplc.csv"),         # validation only
  fit_flags = here("outputs", "ctd_discrete_flags5.csv"),             # cast-fit QC
  npq_fits  = here("outputs", "quench_correction_fits.xlsx"),         # NPQ settings
  decisions = here("files", "manual_decisions.csv")                 # exclusions etc.
)

# Output files
out <- list(
  calibration = here("outputs", paste0("ctd_fluorescence_calibration_stats_", run_date, ".csv")),
  cast_fits   = here("outputs", paste0("ctd_cast_fits_", run_date, ".csv")),
  final       = here("outputs", paste0("flu_qc_", run_date, ".csv"))
)

stations        <- c("KC10", "FZH01")
dark_min_pres   <- 100  # dark offset uses data deeper than this (dbar)
dark_n          <- 10   # ...needs at least this many bins, and uses the n lowest
min_cast_samples <- 3   # casts with fewer discrete samples go to the sensor-wide fit only
sat_span        <- 0.3  # loess span for saturated-profile interpolation
```

## Load data

```{r load}
f_raw     <- read_csv(paths$ctd)
flags     <- read_csv(paths$ctd_flags)
chl_raw   <- read_csv(paths$chl)
hplc_raw  <- read.csv(paths$hplc)
fit_flag  <- read_csv(paths$fit_flags)
npq_fits  <- read_excel(paths$npq_fits)
decisions <- read_decisions(paths$decisions)
```

## 1. CTD profiles and QC

```{r ctd}
f_all <- f_raw %>%
  filter(`Cast Direction Flag` == "d") %>%
  mutate(date = date(`Measurement time`),
         year = year(`Measurement time`)) %>%
  select(castpk = `Cast PK`,
         hakai_id = `Hakai ID`,
         Cruise,
         ctdNum = `CTD serial number`,
         station = Station,
         lat = Latitude...11,
         long = Longitude...12,
         time = `Measurement time`,
         date, year,
         pres = `Pressure (dbar)`,
         flu = `Fluorometry Chlorophyll (ug/L)`,
         flu_flag = `Fluorometry Chlorophyll flag`,
         par = `PAR (umol m-2 s-1)`,
         turb = `Turbidity (FTU)`)

# The join message shows which columns link the QC flags to the profiles.
f_flagged <- f_all %>% left_join(flags)

f_issue <- f_flagged %>% filter(flag != "AV")  # removed profiles, for the figure below
f <- f_flagged %>% filter(flag == "AV", station %in% stations)
```

```{r fig-removed-profiles, eval = make_figures}
ggplot(f_issue %>% filter(pres < 100), aes(x = flu, y = pres)) +
  geom_line(orientation = "y") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(data = f_issue %>% filter(pres < 100) %>% group_by(castpk) %>% slice(1),
            aes(label = comment), x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  facet_wrap(~ castpk, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "Fluorescence", y = "Pressure (dbar)")

ggsave(here("figures", "fluorescence_issue_profiles.png"), width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

## 2. Dark offset

```{r dark-offset}
dark_offsets <- f %>%
  filter(pres > dark_min_pres) %>%
  group_by(castpk, date, station, ctdNum) %>%
  filter(n() >= dark_n) %>%
  slice_min(flu, n = dark_n) %>%
  summarise(dark_offset = median(flu, na.rm = TRUE),
            dark_offset_sd = sd(flu, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_depth = max(pres),
            .groups = "drop")

# Early casts that were too shallow get the nearest deep offset from the same
# sensor. Shallow-derived offsets are biased high (see archive workbook), and
# these sensors' deep offsets are stable, so this adds little error.
f <- f %>%
  left_join(dark_offsets, by = c("castpk", "date", "station", "ctdNum")) %>%
  mutate(dark_offset_filled = is.na(dark_offset)) %>%
  arrange(ctdNum, date) %>%
  group_by(ctdNum) %>%
  fill(dark_offset, dark_offset_sd, .direction = "downup") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(f_offset = pmax(flu - dark_offset, 0))
```

```{r fig-dark-offsets, eval = make_figures}
dark_offsets %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = dark_offset, color = as.factor(ctdNum))) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = dark_offset - dark_offset_sd,
                    ymax = dark_offset + dark_offset_sd), width = 0, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(y = expression(paste("Dark offset (mg ", m^{-3}, ")")),
       title = "Fluorometer dark offsets from deep water (>100 m)") +
  facet_grid(ctdNum ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

ggsave(here("figures", "dark_offsets.png"), width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

## 3. Daily-mean profiles

Replicate casts on the same day are averaged. A few days have casts several
hours apart (e.g. 2017-08-31 FZH01), which adds scatter to the matchups;
matching bottles to the nearest cast in time would be an improvement.

```{r daily-mean}
f_dm <- f %>%
  group_by(date, station, pres, ctdNum) %>%
  summarise(f_dm = mean(f_offset),
            f_sd = sd(f_offset),
            n_prof = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(f_dm = round(f_dm, 2),
         f_lower = f_dm - f_sd,
         f_upper = f_dm + f_sd) %>%
  unite(id, c(date, station, ctdNum), sep = "-", remove = FALSE)
```

## 4. Discrete chlorophyll

Bulk GF/F is used where available, gap-filled with the size-fractionated sum
(complete 3-filter sets only). Flags AV, SVC, ADL and unflagged are accepted:
SVC samples usually look fine (metadata notes on filter handling), and ADL
samples (pre-dilution era, above calibration range) should in theory skew low
but don't obviously. Surface samples (0 m) are set to 1 m to match the CTD.

```{r discrete}
ok_flags <- c("AV", "SVC", "ADL")

c_dm <- chl_raw %>%
  select(date, station = site_id, line_out_depth, filter_type, chla, chla_flag) %>%
  filter(filter_type == "Bulk GF/F",
         chla_flag %in% ok_flags | is.na(chla_flag)) %>%
  group_by(date, station, line_out_depth) %>%
  summarise(chl_dm = mean(chla), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pres = round(line_out_depth)) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  group_by(date, station) %>%
  mutate(n_dep = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(year = year(date),
         pres = if_else(pres == 0, 1, as.numeric(pres)))

# Size-fractionated: daily mean per filter, keep complete 3-filter sets, sum.
# (The middle filter changed from 2 to 3 um; this doesn't affect the sum.)
# Note: unlike bulk, SF depths are not rounded, so a non-integer SF depth will
# not match a CTD bin.
c_sum <- chl_raw %>%
  select(date, station = site_id, line_out_depth, filter_type, chla, chla_flag) %>%
  filter(filter_type != "Bulk GF/F",
         chla_flag %in% ok_flags | is.na(chla_flag),
         !is.na(chla), chla > 0) %>%
  group_by(date, station, line_out_depth, filter_type) %>%
  summarise(avg_chla = mean(chla), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(date, station, line_out_depth) %>%
  filter(n() == 3) %>%
  summarise(sum = sum(avg_chla), .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(pres = line_out_depth) %>%
  mutate(pres = if_else(pres == 0, 1, as.numeric(pres)))

c_join <- c_dm %>%
  full_join(c_sum, by = c("date", "station", "pres")) %>%
  mutate(chl_comb = if_else(is.na(chl_dm), sum, chl_dm)) %>%
  group_by(date, station) %>%
  mutate(n_dep = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(date, station, pres, n_dep, sum, chl_dm, chl_comb) %>%
  mutate(diff = round(chl_dm - sum, 2))

f_dm <- f_dm %>% left_join(c_join, by = c("date", "station", "pres"))
```

```{r fig-discrete-validation, eval = make_figures}
# Bulk vs SF sum (slope ~0.89: bulk slightly higher, possibly pigment loss
# through stacked filters) and combined product vs HPLC (slope ~1.55).
c_join_comp <- c_join %>%
  filter(!is.na(chl_dm), !is.na(sum)) %>%
  mutate(outlier = abs(chl_dm - sum) >= 5)

hplc <- hplc_raw %>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date)) %>%
  group_by(date, site_id, line_out_depth) %>%
  summarise(tchl_dm = mean(all_chl_a), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pres = round(line_out_depth)) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(pres = if_else(pres == 0, 1, as.numeric(pres))) %>%
  rename(station = site_id)

c_join_hplc <- c_join_comp %>%
  filter(!outlier) %>%
  left_join(hplc, by = c("date", "station", "pres")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(tchl_dm), !is.na(chl_comb))

one_to_one_plot <- function(d, x, y, xlab, ylab, colour_outliers = FALSE) {
  fit_d <- if (colour_outliers) filter(d, !outlier) else d
  m <- lm(reformulate(x, y), data = fit_d)
  lims <- range(c(d[[x]], d[[y]]), na.rm = TRUE)
  lab <- sprintf("y = %.2fx + %.2f\nR² = %.3f\nn = %d", coef(m)[2], coef(m)[1],
                 summary(m)$r.squared, nrow(fit_d))
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]])) +
    geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    geom_smooth(data = fit_d, method = "lm", color = "#2166ac", fill = "#2166ac", alpha = 0.2) +
    annotate("text", x = lims[1] + 0.1 * diff(lims), y = lims[2] - 0.1 * diff(lims),
             label = lab, hjust = 0, size = 3.5) +
    coord_fixed(xlim = lims, ylim = lims) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab) +
    theme_bw() + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  if (colour_outliers) {
    p + geom_point(aes(color = outlier), size = 3, alpha = 0.6) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "black", "TRUE" = "#d73027"),
                         labels = c("Included", "Outlier (|diff| >= 5)"), name = NULL)
  } else {
    p + geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.6)
  }
}

p_sf <- one_to_one_plot(c_join_comp, "chl_dm", "sum",
                        expression("Chl"[BULK]~"(mg m"^-3*")"),
                        expression("Chl"[SF-SUM]~"(mg m"^-3*")"), colour_outliers = TRUE)
p_hplc <- one_to_one_plot(c_join_hplc, "tchl_dm", "chl_comb",
                          expression("Chl"[HPLC]~"(mg m"^-3*")"),
                          expression("Chl"[COMB]~"(mg m"^-3*")"))
p_sf
ggsave(here("figures", "chl_comparison.png"), p_sf, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
p_hplc
ggsave(here("figures", "chl_hplc_comparison.png"), p_hplc, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## 5. Cast-by-cast fits

Matchups are split into casts with 3+ discrete samples (cast-specific fits) and
casts with 1-2 samples (used only in the sensor-wide calibration). Individual
matchups listed under `exclude_fit_point` in `manual_decisions.csv` are removed
first; these are mostly discrete samples that appear to miss a narrow SCM.

```{r cast-fits}
point_excl <- decisions %>%
  filter(decision == "exclude_fit_point") %>%
  transmute(id, pres = as.numeric(pres))

f_fit <- f_dm %>% filter(!is.na(chl_comb), !is.na(f_dm))

f_fit_multi <- f_fit %>%
  group_by(date, station, ctdNum) %>%
  filter(n() >= min_cast_samples) %>%
  ungroup()

warn_unmatched(paste(point_excl$id, point_excl$pres),
               paste(f_fit_multi$id, f_fit_multi$pres), "exclude_fit_point")

f_fit_multi <- f_fit_multi %>% anti_join(point_excl, by = c("id", "pres"))

f_fit_few <- f_fit %>%
  group_by(date, station, ctdNum) %>%
  filter(n() < min_cast_samples) %>%
  ungroup()

cast_models <- f_fit_multi %>%
  group_by(date, station, ctdNum) %>%
  group_modify(~ select_cast_model(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unite(id, c(date, station, ctdNum), sep = "-", remove = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(date, station, ctdNum) %>%
  mutate(method = "cast_specific")
```

## 6. Sensor-wide calibrations

```{r calibration}
fit_flag_clean <- fit_flag %>%
  mutate(id = paste(id, ctdNum, sep = "-")) %>%
  select(id, slope_flag = flag)

# Multi-sample casts I judged acceptable (AV), using the surface sample only
# where the cast fit chose to.
f_fit_av <- f_fit_multi %>%
  left_join(cast_models %>% select(id, intercept, slope, r2, p.value,
                                   use_surface, quenched, nobs), by = "id") %>%
  left_join(fit_flag_clean, by = "id") %>%
  filter(slope_flag == "AV") %>%
  filter(use_surface | pres != 1)

few_excl    <- decision_ids(decisions, "exclude_single_depth_cast")
sensor_excl <- decision_ids(decisions, "exclude_single_depth_sensor")
sep_ids     <- decision_ids(decisions, "separate_calibration")
warn_unmatched(few_excl, f_fit_few$id, "exclude_single_depth_cast")
warn_unmatched(sep_ids, f_fit_av$id, "separate_calibration")

f_fit_combined <- bind_rows(
  f_fit_av %>% mutate(data_type = "multiple_depths"),
  f_fit_few %>%
    filter(!id %in% few_excl, !ctdNum %in% sensor_excl) %>%
    mutate(data_type = "single_depth")
) %>%
  assign_calibration_type(sep_ids)

sep_vec <- paste0("c('", paste(sep_ids, collapse = "', '"), "')")

calibration_stats <- f_fit_combined %>%
  group_by(ctdNum, calibration_type) %>%
  group_modify(~ fit_line(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(id_filter = case_when(
    calibration_type == "excl_april" ~ paste0("!id %in% ", sep_vec),
    calibration_type == "april_only" ~ paste0("id %in% ", sep_vec),
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  arrange(match(calibration_type, c("standard", "excl_april", "april_only")), ctdNum) %>%
  select(ctdNum, slope, intercept, r2, adj_r2, p_value, n, calibration_type, id_filter)

calibration_stats
```

```{r fig-calibration, eval = make_figures}
cal_labels <- calibration_stats %>%
  group_by(ctdNum) %>%
  summarise(label = paste(sprintf("%s: y = %.2fx + %.2f, R² = %.2f, n = %d",
                                  calibration_type, slope, intercept, r2, n),
                          collapse = "\n"), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(f_fit_combined, aes(f_dm, chl_comb)) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  geom_smooth(data = ~ filter(.x, data_type == "multiple_depths"), aes(group = id),
              method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_abline(data = calibration_stats,
              aes(slope = slope, intercept = intercept, linetype = calibration_type),
              linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(aes(color = data_type), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = cal_labels, aes(x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = label),
            hjust = 1.02, vjust = -0.3, size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(multiple_depths = "gray30", single_depth = "orange"),
                     name = "Data type") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(standard = "solid", excl_april = "solid", april_only = "dotted"),
                        name = "Calibration") +
  facet_wrap(~ ctdNum, scales = "free", labeller = labeller(ctdNum = ~ paste("Sensor", .x))) +
  labs(x = "CTD fluorescence, dark corrected (f_dm)",
       y = expression(paste("Discrete chlorophyll (mg m"^-3, ")")),
       title = "CTD fluorescence calibrations by sensor",
       subtitle = "Blue = individual cast fits; black = calibration applied; dashed grey = 1:1") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), aspect.ratio = 1)

ggsave(here("figures", "fluorescence_calibration_by_sensor_2026-10-13.png"), width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

```{r apply-calibration}
f_dm_cal <- f_dm %>%
  assign_calibration_type(sep_ids) %>%
  inner_join(calibration_stats %>% select(-id_filter), by = c("ctdNum", "calibration_type")) %>%
  relocate(calibration_type, .after = n) %>%
  mutate(f_calibrated = slope * f_dm)

# Profiles from sensors without a calibration are dropped by the join above.
setdiff(unique(f_dm$ctdNum), unique(calibration_stats$ctdNum))
```

## 7. NPQ hybrid correction

Profiles flagged `AV` in `quench_correction_fits.xlsx` get the hybrid
correction (see `npq_hybrid()` in the functions file). `threshold` and `span`
were tuned per profile with `plot_npq_correction()`. Note that where the
discrete samples stop shallower than the transition depth (e.g. 2016-03-25 and
2016-09-23 FZH01, sampled only to 30 m), `f_final` switches back to
`f_calibrated` below the deepest sample.

```{r npq}
npq_av <- npq_fits %>% filter(quench_cor_flag == "AV")
warn_unmatched(npq_av$id, f_dm_cal$id, "quench_correction_fits")

npq_corrected <- pmap_dfr(
  list(npq_av$id, npq_av$threshold, npq_av$span),
  function(pid, thr, sp) {
    npq_hybrid(filter(f_dm_cal, id == pid), threshold = thr, span = sp) %>%
      select(id, pres, f_calibrated_npq = f_npq)
  }
)

f_dm_cal <- f_dm_cal %>%
  left_join(npq_corrected, by = c("id", "pres")) %>%
  mutate(f_final = if_else(!is.na(f_calibrated_npq), f_calibrated_npq, f_calibrated)) %>%
  select(-f_calibrated_npq)
```

```{r fig-npq-example, eval = make_figures}
# Example; try other profiles/settings when adding rows to the quench file.
plot_npq_correction("2021-09-05-KC10-18032", data = f_dm_cal, threshold = 1, span = 0.3)
```

## 8. Saturated profiles

Two high-biomass KC10 profiles saturated the fluorometer near 5 mg m-3. These
are replaced with a loess interpolation of the discrete samples (1 m
resolution, down to the deepest sample). For these profiles `f_dm` is NA and
`f_calibrated = f_final = interpolated discrete chlorophyll`.

```{r saturated}
sat_keys <- tibble(key = decision_ids(decisions, "replace_saturated")) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(str_sub(key, 1, 10)),
         station = str_sub(key, 12))

sat_interp <- c_join %>%
  semi_join(sat_keys, by = c("date", "station")) %>%
  select(date, station, pres, chla = chl_comb) %>%
  interp_discrete_profiles(span = sat_span)

# Built from all downcasts (the saturated casts may have failed visual QC).
# One row per depth even if there were replicate casts.
sat_rows <- f_all %>%
  semi_join(sat_keys, by = c("date", "station")) %>%
  distinct(date, station, ctdNum, pres, year) %>%
  left_join(sat_interp, by = c("date", "station", "pres")) %>%
  transmute(id = paste(date, station, ctdNum, sep = "-"),
            date, station, ctdNum, year, pres,
            f_final = f_interpolated,
            f_dm = NA_real_,
            f_calibrated = f_final)

f_final <- f_dm_cal %>%
  filter(!id %in% sat_rows$id) %>%
  bind_rows(sat_rows) %>%
  arrange(date, station, pres) %>%
  mutate(profile_correction = case_when(
    id %in% sat_rows$id ~ "saturation_discrete_interp",
    id %in% npq_av$id   ~ "slope_npq_loess",
    TRUE                ~ "slope"
  ))
```

```{r fig-saturated, eval = make_figures}
f_all %>%
  semi_join(sat_keys, by = c("date", "station")) %>%
  filter(pres < 50) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = pres)) +
  geom_line(aes(x = flu, color = "Raw fluorescence", group = castpk), orientation = "y") +
  geom_line(data = filter(sat_interp, pres < 50),
            aes(x = f_interpolated, color = "Interpolated discrete"), orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(data = c_join %>% semi_join(sat_keys, by = c("date", "station")) %>% filter(pres < 50),
             aes(x = chl_comb, color = "Discrete samples"), size = 3) +
  scale_y_reverse(name = "Pressure (dbar)") +
  scale_color_manual(name = "", values = c("Raw fluorescence" = "#2E86AB",
                                           "Interpolated discrete" = "#F18F01",
                                           "Discrete samples" = "#A23B72")) +
  facet_wrap(~ date, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "Chlorophyll (mg m-3)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) + theme(legend.position = "top")

ggsave(here("figures", "sensor_issues_2022.png"), width = 7, height = 8)
```

## Write outputs

```{r write}
write_csv(calibration_stats, out$calibration)
write_csv(cast_models, out$cast_fits)
write_csv(f_final, out$final)
```

## Diagnostics

Use `plot_cast_detailed()` to look at why a cast's matchup is poor.

```{r diagnostics, eval = FALSE}
sensor_medians <- cast_models %>%
  group_by(ctdNum) %>%
  summarise(median_slope = median(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_intercept = median(intercept, na.rm = TRUE))

plot_cast_detailed("2014-06-19-KC10-18066", f_dm, f_fit_multi, cast_models, sensor_medians)
```
